stages.title: CONTEMPORARY-ANCHOR DISCIPLINE
stages.terms: Contemporary-anchor discipline: A February 2026 academic lecture on Puruṣa and Prakṛti is educational context only.
stages.mechanism: A February 2026 academic lecture on Puruṣa and Prakṛti is educational context only.
stages.consequence: ⚠️ Inference: Contemporary mind–body comparisons may clarify the doctrine, but must not be presented as official adoption or as evidence for classical metaphysics.
stages.trap: ⚠️ Inference: Contemporary mind–body comparisons may clarify the doctrine, but must not be presented as official adoption or as evidence for classical metaphysics.
stages.answer: ✅ Search finding: A live August 2026 search repeated a non-official claim that a national “Sāṃkhya paradigm” entered Indian mental-health policy; no official government source verified it.

stages.title: MASTER DISTINCTION GATEWAY
stages.terms: Master verdict: Sāṃkhya is a realist dualism and evolutionism: Prakṛti transforms, Puruṣa witnesses, and liberation occurs through discriminating their radical difference.
stages.mechanism: Master verdict: Sāṃkhya is a realist dualism and evolutionism: Prakṛti transforms, Puruṣa witnesses, and liberation occurs through discriminating their radical difference.
stages.consequence: Conclusion. ⚠️ Therefore the five arguments for Prakṛti and the arguments for Puruṣa are not rhetorical flourishes; they discharge an epistemological obligation created by Sāṃkhya's own three-pramāṇa scheme.
stages.trap: Statement. ✅ Other proposed pramāṇas — upamāna (comparison), arthāpatti (postulation), anupalabdhi (non-apprehension), sambhava (inclusion/probability) and aitihya (traditional report) — are not rejected as useless; they are reduced to, or included within, these three.
stages.answer: Master verdict: Sāṃkhya is a realist dualism and evolutionism: Prakṛti transforms, Puruṣa witnesses, and liberation occurs through discriminating their radical difference.
